33:31: Tin segkwent i iunzen i Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS, u txeddem ayen ilhan, ad as Nefk arraz berdayen, u Nhegga yas d lɣit ukyis.
33:32: A tilawin n Nnbi! Ur tellimt am tlawin nniḍen. Ma tḥezzbemt, ur teţţeccḍemt deg wawal, a kwent isirem umuḍin n wul. Inimt awal uwqim.
33:33: Ilimt deg ixxamen nnkwent. Ur ţcebbiḥemt acebbeḥ n at war tussna imenza. ẒẒẓalemt, zekkimt, ṛaḍimt Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ibɣa kan Ṛebbi a kwent iţwakkes nnkel, a tawacult n Uxxam. U, a kwent Izzizdeg nezzeh.
33:34: Mmektitemt ed ayen i kwent ɣṛan, deg ixxamen nnkwent, n issekniyen n Ṛebbi, akw n ṣṣwab. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga d Laṭif, Iţţuxebbeṛ.
33:35: Ih, imḍuɛen, timḍuɛin, lmumnin argaz tameṭṭut, itubiyen, titubiyin, wid akked tid issawalen tideţ, iṣebṛiyen, tiṣebṛiyin, wid akked tid iţţagwaden, wid akked tid iţseddiqen, wid akked tid iţţuẓumen, wid akked tid iţḥaraben ɣef tuzzuft nnsen, wid akked tid id immektayen aṭas Ṛebbi; i wigi, Ihegga d Ṛebbi ssmaḥ akked warraz abarar.
33:36: Ur issefk ara i win, neɣ tin iumnen, ad smenyafen lameṛ nnsen, ma Iseyya d lameṛ Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS. Win inuqmen Ṛebbi, akked Umazan iS, niɣ innetlaf ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
33:37: Mi tenniḍ i win Iɣat Ṛebbi, u tɣateḍ: "jmaɛ ɣuṛek, tameṭṭut ik, ḥezzeb i Ṛebbi"; teffreḍ deg iman ik, ayen ara d Isban Ṛebbi. Tugadeḍ medden. D Ṛebbi, i iwatan a T tagwadeḍ. Mi s ibra Zayed, Njewo ik yides, iwakken ur teţţili lhejna i lmumnin, ma uɣen tilawin n wid id ssekren, mara ad sent brun. Ad iṣaṛ lameṛ n Ṛebbi.
33:38: Ur telli lhejna f Nnbi, deg wayen Iḥeţţem fellas Ṛebbi; d tannumi n Ṛebbi ɣef imezwura. Lameṛ n Ṛebbi izga iţwafta.
33:39: Wid issawaḍen tibṛatin n Ṛebbi, i T iţţagwaden, ur ţţagwaden yiwen, siwa Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Iqadd i uqeṭṭi.
33:40: Ur illi Muḥemmed d ababat n yiwen seg irgazen nnwen, maca, d Amazan n Ṛebbi, u d aneggaru n lambiyya. Ṛebbi Izga Issen yal cci.
33:41: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed Ṛebbi, mačči d izli.
33:43: D Neţţa i d Inuben fellawen, akked lmalayek, iwakken a kwen Issuffeɣ si tillas ar tafat. Izga Iţḥunu ɣef lmumnin.
33:44: Asmi ara T magren, azul nnsen d: "tifrat"! Ihegga yasen d arraz ukyis.
33:45: A Nnbi! Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir u d aneddaṛ,
33:46: i ineccden ar Ṛebbi, s tsriḥ iS; d asaḍef icaɛlen.
33:47: Becceṛ lmumnin s lfeḍl ameqwṛan i nitni, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi.
33:48: Ur ţţaɣ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Ur ssemḥas, i ccum nnsen. Pţkel ɣef Ṛebbi, Iqadd Ṛebbi d Awkil.
33:49: A wid iumnen! Ma tuɣem tid iumnen, sinna, tebram asent, uqbel ma tennulem tent, ur fellawen ad asent tḥesbem tallit. ɣitet ţent, serrḥet asent, s wudem uwqim.
33:50: A Nnbi! Nḥell ak tilawin iwumi tefkiḍ tiqḍiɛen nnsent, tiklatin ik, si tid i k Iqsed Ṛebbi, iss is n ɛam ik, tid n tɛamtin ik, tid n xal ik, tid n txaltin ik iunagen yidek, tameṭṭut iumnen, ma tefka iman is i Nnbi, ma ibɣa Nnbi a ţ yaɣ. D lemziyya i kečč, war lmumnin. Niɣ Neẓṛa acu i sen Nseyya af tlawin nnsen, akked teklatin nnsen. Iwakken ur teţţili fellak lhejna. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
33:51: A ţţesganiḍ tin i k ihwan segsent. A d tawiḍ ɣuṛek tin i k ihwan, neɣ tin tebɣiḍ si tid tɛazleḍ. Ur fellak tuzzma. Akka i iwulem, iwakken ad qenɛant, ur ɣwebbnent, ad ṛaḍint akw, ayen i sent tefkiḍ. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Ṛebbi Izga d Amusnaw, Iḥellem.
33:52: Ur ak ḥellent tlawin, sya d asawen, neɣ abeddel n tlawin, xas tɛaoeb ik ṣṣifa nnsent, siwa tiklatin ik. Ṛebbi Izga Issikid yal cci.
33:53: A wid iumnen! Ur keččmet ar texxamin n Nnbi, ar awen iɛammed, d inebgawen ar wučči, ur teggunim. Maca, ma teţwɛaṛḍem, kecmet. Mi teččam, sahlet; ur ssiṛxiset ameslay. Ayagi, s tideţ, iqelleq Nnbi. Isetḥa segwen. Ṛebbi ur Iţsetḥi ɣef tideţ. Ma tessutrem asent taɣawsa, ssutret eţ deffir tsabert. Yif it wakka, i tezdeg n wulawen nnwen, akked wulawen nnsent. Ur awen ilaq ara a ţjjerim Amazan n Ṛebbi, neɣ a ţţaɣem tilawin is, deffir es, d awezɣi. Ayagi, ad yili, ar Ṛebbi, d lefḍiḥa.
33:54: Ama tessknem d lḥaoa, neɣ teffrem ţ, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa yal cci.
33:55: Ur telli tiyta degsent af ibabaten nnsent, arraw nnsent, atmaten nnsent, arraw n wamaten nnsent, arraw n tsetmatin nnsent, tilawin nnsent, ticrikin nnsent. Ad ḥezzbent i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Anagi n yal cci.
33:56: Ṛebbi akked lmalayek iS, s tideţ, Nuban ɣef Nnbi. A wid iumnen! Nubet fellas, ternum as azul aḥmayan.
33:57: Ih, wid ijjerin Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, Ixza ten Ṛebbi, di ddunit, di laxeṛt. Ihegga yasen d aɛaqeb isdullun.
33:58: Wid ijjerin lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, ɣef wayen ur ksiben, niɣ bbwin acehrir akked ubekkaḍ n ṣṣeḥ.
33:59: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik, i iss ik, i tlawin n lmumnin, ad jemɛant ijufaṛ nnsent. Pţif akka, a tent ɛaqlen, ur tent ţooerin. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
33:60: Ma ur ḥbisen ara ixabiten, imehzulen n wul, akked wid iţxeṛṛiḍen di Lmadina, ad ak Nebges ɣuṛsen. Sinna, siwa cwiṭ n tallit ara yilin, degs, d loiran ik.
33:61: Ad ţwaxzun anda ten nufan, ad ţwaṭṭfen, ad ţwanɣen akw.
33:62: D tannumi n Ṛebbi ar wid iɛaddan zik. Ur teţţafeḍ, d awezɣi, abeddel, di tannumi n Ṛebbi.
33:63: Steqsan k imdanen, af yimir. Ini: "it Issnen siwa Ṛebbi". Anwa ad ak imlen, amar imir iqeṛb ed?
33:64: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Ixza ijehliyen, Ihegga yasen d uɣud.
33:65: Ad wekkṛen degs, i lebda; ur ţţafen bab, neɣ asettaṛ.
33:66: Ass ideg ara zzin wudmawen nnsen, ar tmes, ad inin: "a yamxix nneɣ! A lemmer nunez i Ṛebbi, u nunez i Umazan!
33:67: Ad inin: "a Mass nneɣ! Nekwni nunez i igeldan nneɣ, i imeqwṛanen nneɣ, telfen aɣ ar yir abrid.
33:68: A Mass nneɣ! Aɛqeb iten berdayen, u Xzu ten s leqseḥ"!
33:69: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţilit am wid i ijjerin Musa. Izekka t Ṛebbi, seg wayen id nnan. Illa ar Ṛebbi d amxallef.
33:70: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, tinim awal umɛin.
33:71: Ad awen Iṣeggem igiten nnwen, ad Isemmeḥ ibekkaḍen nnwen. Win iṛuḍan Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, niɣ ibbwi arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
33:72: Naɛṛeḍ a nefk lamana i igenwan, i tmurt, i idurar. Ugin a ţ ṭṭfen. Ugaden ţ. Ibubb iţ umdan. Neţţa ard amednus ur nessin.
33:73: Ihi, ad Isɛaddi Ṛebbi aɛaqeb af ixabiten akked txabitin, wid akked tid iţcaraken. Ad Issuref Ṛebbi i wid akked tid iumnen. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
34:1: Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, i iIan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. I Neţţa, ccekṛan di laxert. Neţţa, d Bab n ṣṣwab, Iţţuxebbeṛ.
34:2: Iẓṛa ayen ikeččmen di tmurt, ayen id iteffɣen segs, ayen id iţrusun seg igenni, ayen iţţalin ɣuṛes. Neţţa Iţḥunu, Iţsemmiḥ.
34:3: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur aɣ d iţţas yimir". Ini: "xaṭi, s Mass iw, ara kwen id ias"! Amusnaw n tbaḍnit, ur idrig fellaS ubruy ubelkim, ama deg igenwan, ama di ddunit; ama seddaw wannect is, ama sennig es; akw, di Tezmamt iţbegginen.
34:4: Ad Ikafi wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ssmaḥ akked ṛṛeẓq ukyis.
34:5: Wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nneɣ, sfunnugen, widak, fellasen aɛaqeb n twaɣit taqeṛḥant.
34:6: Wid iwumi teţţunefk tmusni, walan ar ayen id irsen ɣuṛek, sɣuṛ Mass ik, d tideţ. Iţţawi s abrid n Uzmir, Amaɛzuz.
34:7: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ad awen nessken argaz, ar awen d yinin ar ma teftutsem, yal aftutes, i kunwi lxelq amaynut?
34:8: Iger ed tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, neɣ d aṛehbani"? Xaṭi, wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, haaten deg uɛaqeb, akked ttelfan uɣmiq.
34:9: Day ur walan ara ayen illan zdat sen, u deffir sen, di tmurt akked igenwan? Ma ihwa yaɣ, a ten Nger seddaw tmurt, neɣ a d Nesseɣli fellasen igezzim seg igenni. Deg wayagi, ih, d assekni i yal amdan ucɛif.
34:10: Niɣ Nefka sɣuṛneɣ lfeḍl i Dawed. A yidurar, alset yides akked ifrax. Nerra yas uzzal d aleqqaq.
34:11: Eṣnaɛ tibedɛiyin n wuzzal, qiss tindar. Xeddmet ayen ilhan. Nek, Pwaliɣ ayen txeddmem.
34:12: I Sliman: aḍu. Win n ṣṣbeḥ, aggur; win n tmeddit, aggur. Nelli yas taɛwint n nnḥas. Kra n leonun ad xedmen fellas, s tsriḥ n Mass is. Win degsen, iḍeṛfen i lameṛ nneɣ, Nessukk fellas, aɛaqeb ujajiḥ.
34:13: Xeddmen as ayen ibɣa: leowamaɛ, tiɛancuṛin, loefnat am iḥḍunen, ticcuytin iqaɛden. Exdem s tnemmirt, a tawacult n Dawed, drus n yimdanen iW i isnemmiren!
34:14: Mi Nseyya fellas tameţţant, ur as faqen ara immut, armi ičča taɛkwazt is, ubaɛɛuc n wakal. Mi iɣli, ḥulfan leonun ar, lemmer day ssinen tabaḍnit, ur qqimen deg uɛaqeb isdullun.
34:15: Niɣ, i Saba, assekni di tnezduɣin nnsen. Snat tebḥirin, ta yeffus, ta zelmeḍ. Eččet si lɣit n Mass nnwen, u snemmret aS. Tamurt ilhan, Mass Iţsemmiḥen.
34:16: Wexxṛen. Nuzen asen aḥemmal n Ɛarim. Tibḥirin nnsen, nerra tent d tibḥirin id iţţaken lɣella ṛẓagen, tammemayt, akked tzegwart taxeṭṭayt.
34:17: Akka ay ten Nqeṭṭi ɣef tijehli nnsen. Day a Nqeṭṭi wur nejhil?
34:18: Nerra garasen u ger temdinin iɣef Nburek, timdinin id iḍehṛen. Nektal tikli garasent: "merḥet degsent di laman, am yiḍ, am ass"!
34:19: Nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! Zziɣwzef tallit ger zziaṛat nneɣ"! Densen iman nnsen. Nerra ten d tiqṣiḍin. Nesqucc iten wakali. Ih, deg wayagi, war ccek, d issekniyen i yal aṣebṛi isnemmiren.
34:20: Niɣ Iblis itebbet ed, segsen, ameyyez is. Vefṛen t, siwa arbaɛ si lmumnin.
34:21: Ur isɛi kra udabu fellasen. Iwakken kan, a Nissin anwa iumnen s laxeṛt, u anwa i illan, fellas, di ccekk. Mass ik Iţḥarab af yal cci.
34:22: Ini: "naɛret wid i teţkabarem, war Ṛebbi. Ur sɛin taẓeyt ubelkim, deg igenwan neɣ di tmurt; ur criken degsen; ur aS illi, garasen, umɛiwen".
34:23: Cafuɛa, sɣuṛeS, tenfaɛ kan win iwumi iţ Irad. Alamma, ma tekkes tugdi seg wulawen nnsen, a d inin: "acu id Inna, Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d tideţ, u Neţţa d Aɛlayen, d Ameqwṛan".
34:24: Ini: "anwa ikwen iţɣaten, si tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Ṛebbi". Nekwni am kunwi, amendeṛ ma nella di nnhaya, neɣ di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
34:25: Ini: "ur teţţuqeṭṭim ɣef wayen nfalṭa, ur neţţuqeṭṭi ɣef wayen txeddmem".
34:26: Ini: "ad aɣ Issemlil Mass nneɣ, sinna, ad Iḥudd garaneɣ, s tideţ. Neţţa d Amḥaddi Amusnaw".
34:27: Ini: "sseknet iyi d wid i tqeṛnem ɣuṛeS, d icriken"! Xaṭi, Neţţa d Ṛebbi Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
34:28: Ur k id Nuzen, i imdanen, armi d uqniɛ; a ţbecṛṛeḍ, a ţnedṛeḍ. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen, ur ssinen.
34:30: Ini: "ɣuṛwen ţţaɛud ass, ur tezmirem a t teswexxṛem, neɣ a t id tesqeṛbem, s saɛa".
34:31: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur neţţamen, d awezɣi, s Leqwṛan agi, neɣ s wayen it id izwaren". Lemmer a ţwaliḍ mara bedden imednas, ar Mass nnsen, ţmeslayen garasen. Ad inin uṛhifen i imzuxiyen: "lemmer mačči d kunwi, yili nella d lmumnin".
34:32: Ad inin imzuxiyen i uṛhifen: "day d nekwni ikwen isfeṛɣen af nnhaya, mi kwen id iusa? Xaṭi, tellam d ibeɣwḍiyen".
34:33: Ad inin uṛhifen, i imzuxiyen: "xaṭi! Nncub, iḍ akked wass, mi tḥeţţmem, fellaneɣ, a nagwi Ṛebbi, u ad aS negg tanudda". Ffren nndama mi walan aɛaqeb. Nerra tiqwlaḍin ɣef imegṛaḍ n wid ijehlen. Day ara ţţuqeṭṭin ɣef wayen ur xdimen?
34:34: Ur Nuzen ara kra uneddaṛ ar temdint, mebla ma nnan imeṛkantiyen is: "nekwni, ih, nugwi ayen is id teţţuceggɛam".
34:35: Nnan: "nekwni, nɣelb ik ayla, tarwa. Ur nelli d wid ara iţţuqeṭṭin".
34:36: Ini: "ihi Mass iw Iţɣiti win i S ihwan u Iwezzen; maca, tegwti n imdanen, ur ssinen".
34:37: Mačči d ayla nnwen, neɣ d tarwa nnwen, ara kwen id iẓẓiẓen nezzeh ɣuṛneɣ, siwa wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I nitni arraz berdayen, ilmend n wayen xedmen. Ad ilin, di laman, di tɣuṛfatin.
34:38: Ma d wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nneɣ, sfunnugen, widak a d rsen i uɛaqeb.
34:39: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Iţɣiti win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Iwezzen as. Ayen akw ara tefkem n cci, ad awen t id Irr. Neţţa, Yif akw imɣiten".
34:40: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, akken ma llan, imiren ad Yini i lmalayek: "wigi, day llan ɛabden kwent"?
34:41: A d inint: "gedha s yiseK! D Kečč ay d Bab nneɣ, war nitni. Xaṭi, llan ɛabden leonun. Tegwti degsen umnen yissen".
34:42: Assa, ur imlik yiwen i wayeḍ, segwen, abaɣuṛ neɣ ccqa. A Nini i wid idensen: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb n tmes, i tellam tnekṛem t"!
34:43: Ma ɣṛan asen issekniyen nneɣ iţbegginen, ad inin: "wagi d argaz kan, i ibɣan a kwen istixeṛ, seg wayen llan ɛabden imezwura nnwen". Ad inin: "ayagi, siwa d tikerkas id innulfan". Wid ijehlen i tideţ, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "ayagi d ssḥur n ṣṣeḥ kan"!
34:44: Ur asen Nefki tizmamin, ara lemden; ur asen d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaṛ.
34:45: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Ur asen tebbwiḍ ara tis mraw n wayen i iţţunefken mi skaddben imazanen iW. A tuzzma W, imiren!
34:46: Ini: "ar yiwet kan, ara kwen nabiɣ: a ţbeddem zdat Ṛebbi, di sin, neɣ weḥḥedwen; sinna, a d tesmektim. Ameddakwel nnwen ur illi d aṛehbani. Neţţa d aneddaṛ nnwen kan, uqbel aɛaqeb uqsiḥ".
34:47: Ini: "ur awen ssutreɣ kra n teqdiɛt; aţan nnwen. Ih, taqdiɛt iw, ar Ṛebbi kan. Neţţa, ɣef yal cci, d Anagi".
34:48: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Iţqeddim tideţ, d Amusnaw n tbaḍnit".
34:49: Ini: "tusa d tideţ, ur d nezzunt tkerkas, ur d ţţalsent".
34:50: Ini: "ma nnetlafeɣ, nnetlafeɣ kan i iman iw. Ma ţwanhaɣ, d ayen iyi d Iweḥḥa Mass iw. Neţţa, ih, d Aqṛib, Isell".
34:51: Lemmer a ţwaliḍ mi xelɛan, tarewla ur telli. Pwaṭṭfen, si tama iqeṛben.
34:52: Nnan: "numen yis". Amek ara d ssiwḍen, si tama ibaɛden?
34:53: Niɣ llan zik, nekṛen t. Rran akin tabaḍnit, si tama ibaɛden.
34:54: Ad yili ufṣil, garasen d wayen ctaqen, akken teḍṛa, zik, d wid i ten icban. Ih, nitni llan di ccekk imcebbwel.
35:1: Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, i Irran lmalayek d timersulin sut sin, kraḍ, akked kuẓ iferrawen. Irennu, di lxelq, ayen i S ihwan. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer i yal cci.
35:2: Ayen Ifka Ṛebbi uḥunu, i medden, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ayen Iṭṭef, ur izmir yiwen a t id iazen, deffir eS. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
35:3: A yimdanen! Mmektit ed aɣiti nnwen sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Day illa uxellaq, war Ṛebbi, ikwen iṛeẓqen seg igenni akked tmurt? Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, ihi acimi tessaɛwajem?
35:4: Ma nekṛen k, niɣ ţwanekṛen imazanen, uqbel ik. Ar Ṛebbi, ara qqlen lumuṛ.
35:5: A yimdanen! Ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ. Ur kwen teţɣuṛṛu tmeddurt n ddunit! Ur kwen iţkellix umɣweṛṛi, af Ṛebbi!
35:6: Cciṭan, s tideţ, d acengu nnwen. Ḥesbet eţ d acengu. Issawal kan, i ukabar is, ad ilin seg wat tmes.
35:7: I wid ijehlen, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ. I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaḥ akked warraz meqqwṛen.
35:8: Day win iwumi Icebbeḥ yir igiten is, iwakken ad ioɛal gerzen…? S tideţ, Ṛebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Ur hellek ara iman ik, fellasen. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa acu la ṣṣenɛen.
35:9: Ṛebbi i Iţţaznen aḍu, issalayen asigna. Neţţawi t ar tmurt immuten, Nessidir ed, yis, akal, deffir tmeţţant is. Akka, tanekra.
35:10: Win ibɣan tazmert, tazmert akw ar Ṛebbi. Awal ukyis iţţali ɣuṛeS. Igi ilhan, Iteg as ccan. Aɛaqeb uqsiḥ i wid iţţandin tucmitin. A ţţemḥu tandit nnsen.
35:11: Ixelq ikwen Ṛebbi seg wakal; sinna, si tiqqit; sinna, Irra kwen d tiyugiwin. Ur treffed tadist, ur teţţarew nnta, siwa ma Iẓṛa t. Ur Izziɣwzif laɛmeṛ i umuddir, ur as t Issenqas, siwa ma di tezmamt. Ayagi, ih, d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
35:12: Ur aɛdilen sin ilellen: wa zeddig, ẓid, iwata i tissit; wayeḍ d ameṛɣan, d aṛẓagan. Segsen teţţeţţem aksum aleqqaq, teţţekksem d iɛqqucen i teţţeqnem. Twalaḍ sfina teţcerrig iten, iwakken a ţnadim lfeḍl iS. Amar a ţţesnemmrem.
35:13: Issekcam iḍ deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiḍ. Iḥeţţem i yiṭij akked waggur, ad lḥun ar lajel iţwassnen. D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda. Wid i tnaɛṛem, war Neţţa, ur rebḥen iclem utemṛiw.
35:14: Ma tnaɛṛem ten, ur sellen i tnaɛṛit nnwen. Xas slan, ur awen d ţţaran. Ass n tnekra, ad nekṛen ccerk nnwen. Ur k iţxebbiṛ yiwen am Win Iţţuxebbṛen.
35:15: A yimdanen! Kunwi d imeɣban zdat Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
35:16: Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.
35:17: I Ṛebbi, ayagi, ur illi d aẓayan.
35:18: Win ibubben ur iţbibbi taɛkkwemt n wayeḍ. Ma isuter ed afus win iɛabban, ur s iţwakkas wacemma, xas ma si llezm is. Nabi kan wid iţţagwaden Mass nnsen di tbaḍnit, u ţẓallan. Win iţzekkin, i iman is kan i iţzekki. Tuɣalin ar Ṛebbi.
35:22: Ur aɛdilen imuddiren akked lmeggtin. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issel i win i S ihwan. Kečč, ur tezmireḍ a ţţesleḍ i wid illan di tneṭlin.
35:24: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tideţ, d abeccaṛ, d aneddaṛ. Ur illi lois, mebla ma iusa t id uneddaṛ.
35:25: Ma skaddben k, niɣ skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, s Ihellilen, s Tezmamt timnewweṛt.
35:26: Dɣa Ssemḥalqeɣ i wid ijehlen. Amek tuzzma W imiren!
35:27: Ur twalaḍ ara Ṛebbi Isseɣli d aman seg igenni? Nessuffeɣ ed, yissen, ţţemṛa n yal ini. Deg idurar, isṛiden icebḥanen, izegwaɣen n yal ini, akked iberkanen maḍi.
35:28: Imdanen, lewḥuc, lmal, n yal ini ula d nitni. Akka, ger imdanen iS, d imusnawen kan i iţţagwaden Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Iţsemmiḥ
35:29: Ih, wid iqqaṛen Tazmamt n Ṛebbi, iţẓallan, iţseddiqen seg wayen iten Nɣat, s tuffra neɣ ɛinani, ad ssirmen ttjaṛa ur neţquccu.
35:30: Akken ad asen Ifk tiqḍaɛin nnsen, ad asen Irnu si lfeḍl iS. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţţara tajmilt.
35:31: Ayen i k Nweḥḥa, si Tezmamt, d tideţ id itebbten ayen iţ id izwaren. Ih, Ṛebbi, ɣef imdanen iS, Iţţuxebbeṛ, Iţwali ten.
35:32: Sinna, Nerra d iweṛṛaten n Tezmamt, wid Nefren, ger imdanen nneɣ. Garasen, llan win idensen iman is, garasen alemmas, garasen win izeggwiren ar lxiṛ, s wannuf n Ṛebbi. Wagi d lfeḍl ameqwṛan.
35:33: Loennet n Ɛaden, ara kecmen. Din, ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb, akked tyuqat. Leḥrir, di lebsa nnsen.
35:34: Ad inin: "cekṛan i Ṛebbi i Issaferen fellaɣ leɣwben. Ih, Mass nneɣ Iţsemmiḥ, Iţţara tajmilt.
35:35: I aɣ Irran, s lefḍl iS, axxam i tnezduɣt; ur aɣ iţnal, degs, wugur; ur aɣ iţnal, degs, ɛaggu".
35:36: I wid ijehlen, times n Loahennama. Ur teţfukku fellasen, ad mmten; ur iţţifsus, fellasen, uɛaqeb is. Akka, ay Neţqeṭṭi yal ajehli.
35:37: Degs, ad ţţuɣun: "a Mass nneɣ! Ssuffeɣ aneɣ, a nexdem ayen ilhan, mačči am akken nella nxeddem"! Day ur awen Nesseɣwzef ara laɛmeṛ, akken a d immekti win id ismektayen? Iusa kwen id uneddaṛ. Ihi jeṛṛbet. I imednas, ur illi umɛiwen.
35:38: Ṛebbi Issen tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iẓṛa i illan deg idmaren.
35:39: D Neţţa i kwen Iran d igensas di tmurt. Win ijehlen, tijehli s mgal iman is. Tijehli ijehliyen, siwa aɣunzu i trennu ar Mass nnsen. Tijehli ijehliyen, siwa taxessaṛt i trennu.
35:40: Ini: "twalam icriken nnwen, la tnaɛṛem, war Ṛebbi; sseknet iyi d acu xelqen, si tmurt, neɣ ma sɛan amur deg igenwan, neɣ ma Nefka yasen Tazmamt i sen d iţbegginen? Xaṭi, aɛahed imednas, garasen, d aɣuṛṛu kan.
35:41: D Ṛebbi, s tideţ, i Iṭfen tamurt akked igenwan, ur ɣellin ara. Lemmer ad ɣlin, ur illi yiwen, deffir eS, ara ten iṭṭfen. Neţţa, ih, Izga Iḥellem, Iţsemmiḥ.
35:42: Gullen s Ṛebbi, tagalit meqwṛen, ar ma iusa ten id uneddaṛ, ar ad ddun d ubrid, sennig akw leoyus. Mi ten id iusa uneddaṛ, i asen d irna, siwa tugin,
35:43: temɣweṛ di tmurt, akked tnaɛuṛt tucmiţ. Ur teţţaṭṭaf tnaɛuṛt tucmiţ, siwa bab is. Day ur muqlen ara ar tannumi imezwura? Ur teţţafeḍ, d awezɣi, abeddel di tannumi n Ṛebbi. Ur teţţafeḍ ara adewwel di tannumi n Ṛebbi.
35:44: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren? Llan ɣelben ten tazmert. Ur illi win ara sfunngen Ṛebbi, s wacemma, deg igenwan, neɣ di tmurt. Neţţa, ih, Izga d Amusnaw, d Uzmir.
35:45: Lemmer Iţqeṭṭi Ṛebbi imdanen, ɣef wayen kesben, ur Iţţaooa kra n lxelq sufella n tmurt. Maca, Iswexxiṛ iten, ar lajel iţwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ihi, Ṛebbi, deg imdanen iS, Izga Iţwali.
36:6: iwakken a ţnedṛeḍ agdud; ur ţwanedṛen imezwura nnsen, dɣa stehzan.
36:7: Niɣ iṣaṛ wawal, ɣef tegwti degsen, dɣa ur uminen.
36:8: Ih, Nurez iten si tmegṛaḍ ar tmira, dɣa ndellen, ur ṭṭinizen.
36:9: Nerra aḥdid zdat sen, aḥdid deffir sen. Nesbur asen, ihi ur ţwalin.
36:10: Iɛuḍa fellasen: ama tnubaḍ ten, neɣ ur ten tnubaḍ; ur ţţamnen.
36:11: Nabi kan wid iṭṭafaṛen asmekti, iţţagwaden Aḥnin, di tbaḍnit. Ihi, becceṛ it s ssmaḥ, akked warraz ukyis.
36:12: Ih, Nekwni Nessidir lmeggtin. Neţţaru ayen xeddmen akked lateṛ nnsen. Neḥseb yal cci di Tezmamt iţbegginen.
36:13: Awi asen d amedya: at temdint, mi ten id usan imazanen.
36:14: Mi sen Nuzen sin, nekṛen ten. Null s wis kraḍ. Nnan: "nekwni d imazanen ɣuṛwen".
36:15: Nnan: "kunwi d imdanen kan, am nekwni. Aḥnin ur d Issers acemma. Kunwi, teskiddibem kan".
36:16: Nnan: "Mass nneɣ Iẓṛa, s tideţ, ar ɣuṛwen id neţţuceggaɛ.
36:18: Nnan: "war ccekk, tesskeḥsem aɣ. Ma ur teḥbisem ara, a kwen neṛoem, u a nessuk fellawen, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
36:19: Nnan: "lkeḥs nnwen yidwen. Day imi i kwen smektin? Maca, kunwi d agdud amaɛfun".
36:20: Iusa d si ṭeṛf ibaɛden n temdint, urgaz s tazzla. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ddut d imazanen!
36:21: Ddut d wid ur awen d nessuter taqḍiɛt, nitni ţwanhan.
36:22: Amek ur ɛabdeɣ ara Win iyi d Ixelqen, u ɣuṛeS tuɣalin nnwen?
36:23: Day ad sɛuɣ, war Neţţa, iṛebbiten? Ur iyi d teţţawi acemma cafuɛa nnsen, ma Irad iyi Uḥnin ccqa; ur iyi ţselliken.
36:24: Yili nek, war ccekk, di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
36:25: Nek, umneɣ s Mass nnwen. Ihi selt iyi d".
36:26: Nnan as: "ekcem ar Loennet"! Inna: "annaɣ, a lemmer ad iẓeṛ ugdud iw,
36:27: amek iyi Isemmeḥ Mass iw, u Irra yi seg imaɛzuzen"?
